display.purpose: Page-defining climbing language and branded states.

body.purpose: Task copy, labels, forms, and session data.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Color, border, focus, and press feedback.

motion.name: hold-settle
motion.purpose: Branded hold arrival on welcome and error moments.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action on a Bouldy surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:48px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0 20px; background:var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); color:var(--accent-ink, white); font:700 14px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; transition:filter 180ms ease-out,transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(.97); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: A secondary completion action on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { min-height:48px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0 20px; background:oklch(0.22 0.003 0); color:oklch(0.98 0 0); font:700 14px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; transition:transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Route name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="e.g. Blue Note"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; color:oklch(0.16 0 0); font:600 14px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:48px; border:1px solid oklch(0.87 0.003 0); border-radius:12px; background:transparent; padding:0 14px; color:oklch(0.16 0 0); font:400 16px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; outline:none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Feedback Message
components.description: Inline error feedback that remains readable without shouting.
components.html: We couldn’t save that attempt. Try again.
components.css: .ds-feedback { margin:0; border-radius:12px; padding:12px 16px; background:oklch(0.94 0.04 27); color:oklch(0.4 0.16 27); font:600 14px/1.5 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: A compact section title with optional contextual count.
components.css: .ds-section-heading { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; color:oklch(0.16 0 0); } .ds-section-heading h2 { margin:0; font:800 24px/1 'Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-section-heading span { color:oklch(0.42 0.003 0); font:400 14px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Session Summary
components.description: The flat dark snapshot used for current and recent climbing sessions.
components.css: .ds-summary { border-radius:16px; padding:20px; background:oklch(0.22 0.003 0); color:oklch(0.98 0 0); } .ds-summary span { color:oklch(0.75 0.003 0); font:600 12px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-summary strong { display:block; margin-top:8px; font:800 28px/1 'Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-summary p { margin:10px 0 0; color:oklch(0.75 0.003 0); font:400 14px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Result Badge
components.css: .ds-result { display:inline-flex; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px; background:oklch(0.92 0.07 145); color:oklch(0.35 0.14 145); font:700 12px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Three equal task destinations with one active indicator.
components.html: HomeSessionsGyms
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; border-top:1px solid oklch(0.87 0.003 0); background:oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-tab { position:relative; flex:1; padding:16px 8px; color:oklch(0.54 0.003 0); text-align:center; text-decoration:none; font:500 11px Geist,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-active { color:var(--accent, oklch(0.56 0.22 27)); } .ds-active::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:calc(50% - 9px); bottom:6px; width:18px; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:currentColor; }

narrative.overview: Bouldy feels like the compact notebook a climber reaches for between attempts: direct, durable, personal, and fast to scan with chalky hands. Its mobile-only canvas pairs hard-working neutral surfaces with one decisive send-red accent, gym-signage display type, quiet interface text, and detailed climbing holds used as functional identity markers.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed climbing identity with readable interface text
Tactile hold assets used with restraint

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Send Red marks the current action or state. If several unrelated elements compete in red, remove red until the hierarchy is obvious.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed speaks for climbing identity; Geist speaks for interaction.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Resting cards and controls have no drop shadow.

dos: Do build edge-to-edge at 430px and below.
Do use shared UI primitives before writing new visual markup.
Do pair every loading mutation with visible feedback.
donts: Don't use cream, gradients, glassmorphism, or sketch-style SVGs.
Don't create page-local styling when a shared component can own it.
